html:
Killaka Asanajaqi (Quillacas Asanaques) was one of the Aymara lordships of the southern Andean high plateau, around Lake Poopó in what is now Oruro, Bolivia.

It belonged to the wider Charcas federation with its neighbours the Charka and Qhara Qhara, and was absorbed by the Inca Empire in the 1400s. Herders of llamas and alpacas lived beside the Uru fishers of the lake. Under Spanish rule the lords of these groups kept some standing as local chiefs. Today Jach'a Suyu Killaka Asanajaqi is one of the Indigenous nations that organise the ayllus of the region.
sum: Killaka Asanajaqi (Quillacas Asanaques) was one of the Aymara lordships of the southern Andean high plateau, around Lake Poopó in what is now Oruro, Bolivia.
